tiles.title: Endpoint alerts over time by severity
MITRE ATT&CK techniques in endpoint alerts
Office / PDF / browser apps spawning shells or LOLBins
Rare processes across the fleet (seen on one device)
Registry hive / NTDS.dit / shadow copy credential theft
Autostart registry changes (Run keys, Winlogon, IFEO, services)
Log clearing, audit and firewall tampering
Account fan-out (one account logging on to many devices)
RDP logons (internal and from the internet)
Remote execution (PsExec, WMI, WinRM, PowerShell remoting)
Internal scanning / lateral fan-out over SMB, RDP, WinRM, RPC
Scripts and LOLBins connecting to the internet
Beaconing (regular connections to the same external host)
Connections to suspicious ports (C2, Tor, reverse shells)
Rare external destinations (contacted by one device)
Recovery inhibition (shadow copies, backups, boot recovery)
Security, backup and database services stopped
Attack surface reduction and Controlled Folder Access events
Inbound internet connections to RDP / SMB / SSH / WinRM
DLLs executed from user-writable paths (rundll32 / regsvr32)
Unified device timeline (set Device or Account)

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let EpAlerts = external_table('AlertInfo')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where ServiceSource has_any ("Endpoint", "Defender for Endpoint", "Antivirus") or DetectionSource has_any ("EDR", "Antivirus", "Endpoint", "Custom detection", "Automated investigation")
| extend PA = pack_all()
| project AlertTime = TimeGenerated, AlertId, Title, Severity, Category, DetectionSource, Techniques = tostring(PA.AttackTechniques);
let AlertDev = external_table('AlertEvidence')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend PE = pack_all()
| extend DevName = tostring(PE.DeviceName), EvUser = tostring(PE.AccountName)
| where isnotempty(DevName)
| summarize Users = make_set_if(EvUser, isnotempty(EvUser), 5) by AlertId, DevName
| where isempty(_device) or DevName contains _device;
EpAlerts
| join kind=inner (AlertDev | distinct AlertId) on AlertId
| where Severity =~ "High"
| summarize HighAlerts = dcount(AlertId)

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Proc = external_table('DeviceProcessEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_device) or DeviceName contains _device
| where isempty(_account) or AccountName =~ _account or AccountUpn =~ _account;
Proc
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "powershell_ise.exe") or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
| where isnotempty(ProcessCommandLine)
| extend Cmd = tolower(ProcessCommandLine)
| extend Encoded = Cmd matches regex @"-e(nc|ncodedcommand)?\s+[a-z0-9+/=]{20,}" or Cmd has "frombase64string",
         Download = Cmd has_any ("downloadstring", "downloadfile", "invoke-webrequest", "iwr ", "net.webclient", "start-bitstransfer", "http://", "https://"),
         Exec = Cmd has_any ("invoke-expression", "iex(", "iex (", "| iex"),
         Hidden = Cmd has_any ("-w hidden", "-windowstyle hidden", "-nop", "-noprofile", "bypass", "-noni")
| extend Score = toint(Encoded) * 3 + toint(Download) * 3 + toint(Exec) * 2 + toint(Hidden)
| where Score >= 2
| extend Severity = case(Score >= 6, "1-High", Score >= 4, "2-Medium", "3-Low")
| project TimeGenerated, Severity, Score, DeviceName, AccountName, ParentProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName, Encoded, Download, Exec, Hidden, ProcessCommandLine
| order by Severity asc, Score desc, TimeGenerated desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Proc = external_table('DeviceProcessEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_device) or DeviceName contains _device
| where isempty(_account) or AccountName =~ _account or AccountUpn =~ _account;
Proc
| extend Cmd = tolower(ProcessCommandLine), F = tolower(FileName)
| extend Technique = case(
    F == "certutil.exe" and Cmd has_any ("urlcache", "-decode", "-decodehex", "-split", "http"), "certutil download/decode",
    F == "mshta.exe" and Cmd has_any ("http", "javascript", "vbscript", ".hta"), "mshta remote/script",
    F == "rundll32.exe" and Cmd has_any ("javascript:", "\\appdata\\", "\\temp\\", "\\programdata\\", "\\users\\public\\", ",#1", "url.dll", "zipfldr", "advpack"), "rundll32 proxy execution",
    F == "regsvr32.exe" and Cmd has_any ("/i:http", "scrobj", "/i:\\\\"), "regsvr32 squiblydoo",
    F == "bitsadmin.exe" and Cmd has_any ("/transfer", "/addfile", "/setnotifycmdline"), "bitsadmin transfer",
    F == "wmic.exe" and Cmd has_any ("process call create", "/node:", "shadowcopy"), "wmic execution",
    F in ("msbuild.exe", "installutil.exe", "regasm.exe", "regsvcs.exe") and Cmd has_any ("\\temp\\", "\\appdata\\", "\\users\\public\\", "/u", "/logfile="), "trusted developer utility proxy",
    F == "cmstp.exe" and Cmd has "/s", "cmstp bypass",
    F in ("curl.exe", "wget.exe") and Cmd has_any ("http", "-o ", "--output"), "curl/wget download",
    F == "msiexec.exe" and Cmd has_any ("http://", "https://"), "msiexec remote install",
    F in ("wscript.exe", "cscript.exe") and Cmd has_any (".js", ".jse", ".vbs", ".vbe", ".wsf") and Cmd has_any ("\\temp\\", "\\downloads\\", "\\appdata\\"), "script host from user path",
    F == "esentutl.exe" and Cmd has_any ("/y", "/vss"), "esentutl copy",
    "")
| where isnotempty(Technique)
| extend Severity = case(Cmd has_any ("http://", "https://"), "1-High (remote payload)", Technique has_any ("proxy", "bypass", "squiblydoo"), "2-Medium", "3-Low")
| summarize Executions = count(), Devices = dcount(DeviceName), DeviceList = make_set(DeviceName, 5), Accounts = make_set(AccountName, 5),
            SampleCommand = take_any(ProcessCommandLine), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Severity, Technique, FileName
| order by Severity asc, Executions desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);

| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)

Proc
| where FileName endswith ".exe" or FileName endswith ".scr" or FileName endswith ".com"
| extend Path = tolower(FolderPath)
| where Path has_any (UserPaths)
| summarize Executions = count(), Devices = dcount(DeviceName), DeviceList = make_set(DeviceName, 5), Accounts = make_set(AccountName, 5),
            Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 5), Paths = make_set(FolderPath, 3), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by FileName, SHA256
| extend Severity = case(Devices == 1 and Executions <= 3, "2-Medium (rare)", Devices >= 5, "3-Low (widespread)", "3-Low")
| order by Devices asc, FirstSeen desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Proc = external_table('DeviceProcessEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_device) or DeviceName contains _device
| where isempty(_account) or AccountName =~ _account or AccountUpn =~ _account;
let Evt = external_table('DeviceEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_device) or DeviceName contains _device
| where isempty(_account) or InitiatingProcessAccountName =~ _account;
let Benign = dynamic(["msmpeng.exe","mssense.exe","senseir.exe","sensecncproxy.exe","svchost.exe","csrss.exe","wininit.exe","lsm.exe","wmiprvse.exe","taskmgr.exe","mrt.exe","lsass.exe","services.exe","vmtoolsd.exe","sensendr.exe","mpdefendercoreservice.exe"]);
union
 (Proc
  | where ProcessCommandLine has "lsass" or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("comsvcs.dll, minidump", "comsvcs.dll,#24", "MiniDump", "sekurlsa", "nanodump", "lsassy")
  | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("minidump", "procdump", "-ma", "comsvcs", "sekurlsa", "nanodump", "dump", "lsassy")
  | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, Account = AccountName, Process = FileName, Detail = ProcessCommandLine, Source = "Process command line"),
 (Evt
  | where ActionType in ("OpenProcessApiCall", "ReadProcessMemoryApiCall") and FileName =~ "lsass.exe"
  | where tolower(InitiatingProcessFileName) !in (Benign)
  | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, Account = InitiatingProcessAccountName, Process = InitiatingProcessFileName, Detail = strcat(ActionType, " ", InitiatingProcessCommandLine), Source = "LSASS handle access")
| extend Severity = case(Detail has_any ("minidump", "comsvcs", "sekurlsa", "procdump", "nanodump"), "1-High (dump)", "2-Medium (handle access)")
| order by Severity asc, TimeGenerated desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Logon = external_table('DeviceLogonEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_device) or DeviceName contains _device
| where isempty(_account) or AccountName =~ _account;
let Threshold = 10;
Logon
| where ActionType == "LogonFailed"
| summarize Failures = count(), Accounts = dcount(AccountName), AccountList = make_set(AccountName, 10), Types = make_set(LogonType), Reasons = make_set(FailureReason, 5),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by DeviceName, RemoteIP
| extend PublicSource = isnotempty(RemoteIP) and not(ipv4_is_private(RemoteIP)) and RemoteIP !in ("127.0.0.1", "::1", "-")
| extend Severity = case(Failures >= Threshold and PublicSource, "1-High (internet brute force)", Accounts >= 5, "2-High (password spray)", Failures >= Threshold, "3-Medium", "4-Low")
| order by Severity asc, Failures desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Reg = external_table('DeviceRegistryEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_device) or DeviceName contains _device
| where isempty(_account) or InitiatingProcessAccountName =~ _account;
let UserPaths = dynamic([@"\appdata\local\temp\", @"\downloads\", @"\users\public\", @"\programdata\", @"\appdata\roaming\", @"\windows\temp\", @"\perflogs\"]);
Reg
| where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet", "RegistryKeyCreated")
| where RegistryKey has_any (@"\CurrentVersion\Run", @"\CurrentVersion\RunOnce", @"\Winlogon", @"\Image File Execution Options", @"\CurrentControlSet\Services", @"\Explorer\Shell Folders", @"\Policies\Explorer\Run", @"\Active Setup\Installed Components")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("msiexec.exe", "trustedinstaller.exe", "tiworker.exe", "msmpeng.exe", "mssense.exe", "svchost.exe", "services.exe", "officeclicktorun.exe", "onedrivesetup.exe", "teams.exe")
| extend Data = tolower(RegistryValueData)
| extend Severity = case(Data has_any (UserPaths) or Data has_any ("powershell", "cmd /c", "mshta", "rundll32", "regsvr32", "wscript", "http"), "1-High (suspicious payload)",
                         RegistryKey has "Image File Execution Options" and RegistryValueName =~ "Debugger", "1-High (IFEO hijack)", "3-Low")
| project TimeGenerated, Severity, DeviceName, RegistryKey, RegistryValueName, RegistryValueData, Process = InitiatingProcessFileName, Account = InitiatingProcessAccountName
| order by Severity asc, TimeGenerated desc
| take 50

  | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, Account = AccountName, Type = "Command line", Detail = ProcessCommandLine),

| where ActionType == "LogonSuccess" and LogonType in ("Network", "RemoteInteractive", "NewCredentials")
| where AccountName !endswith "$" and AccountName !in~ ("system", "local service", "network service", "anonymous logon", "dwm-1", "umfd-0")
| summarize Devices = dcount(DeviceName), DeviceList = make_set(DeviceName, 15), Logons = count(), Types = make_set(LogonType), SourceIPs = make_set(RemoteIP, 10),
            Admin = countif(tostring(IsLocalAdmin) in~ ("true", "1")), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by AccountDomain, AccountName
| extend Severity = case(Devices >= Threshold and Admin > 0, "1-High (admin fan-out)", Devices >= Threshold, "2-Medium (fan-out)", "3-Low")
| order by Severity asc, Devices desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Logon = external_table('DeviceLogonEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_device) or DeviceName contains _device
| where isempty(_account) or AccountName =~ _account;
Logon
| where LogonType == "RemoteInteractive"
| extend Public = isnotempty(RemoteIP) and RemoteIP !in ("-", "::1", "127.0.0.1") and not(ipv4_is_private(RemoteIP))
| summarize Logons = countif(ActionType == "LogonSuccess"), Failures = countif(ActionType == "LogonFailed"), Accounts = make_set(AccountName, 10), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by DeviceName, RemoteIP, Public
| extend Country = iff(Public, tostring(geo_info_from_ip_address(RemoteIP).country), "Internal")
| extend Severity = case(Public and Logons > 0, "1-High (internet RDP success)", Public, "2-Medium (internet RDP attempts)", Failures >= 10, "3-Medium (internal failures)", "4-Low")
| order by Severity asc, Logons desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Proc = external_table('DeviceProcessEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_device) or DeviceName contains _device
| where isempty(_account) or AccountName =~ _account or AccountUpn =~ _account;
Proc
| extend Cmd = tolower(ProcessCommandLine)
| extend Technique = case(
    FileName in~ ("psexec.exe", "psexec64.exe", "paexec.exe") or FileName =~ "psexesvc.exe" or InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "psexesvc.exe", "PsExec",
    InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "wmiprvse.exe" and FileName in~ ("cmd.exe", "powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "rundll32.exe", "mshta.exe"), "WMI remote execution",
    FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and Cmd has "/node:", "WMIC remote",
    InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "wsmprovhost.exe" or FileName =~ "winrs.exe", "WinRM / PowerShell remoting",
    Cmd has_any ("invoke-command", "enter-pssession", "new-pssession") and Cmd has "-computername", "PowerShell remoting (client)",
    FileName =~ "sc.exe" and Cmd matches regex @"sc(\.exe)?\s+\\\\", "Remote service control",
    FileName =~ "schtasks.exe" and Cmd has "/s ", "Remote scheduled task",
    "")
| where isnotempty(Technique)
| summarize Executions = count(), Accounts = make_set(AccountName, 5), Samples = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 3), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by DeviceName, Technique
| extend Severity = case(Technique in ("PsExec", "WMI remote execution", "Remote service control"), "1-High", "2-Medium")
| order by Severity asc, Executions desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Net = external_table('DeviceNetworkEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_device) or DeviceName contains _device
| where isempty(_account) or InitiatingProcessAccountName =~ _account;
let Shells = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","powershell_ise.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","msbuild.exe","installutil.exe","wmic.exe","cmstp.exe","curl.exe"]);
Net
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (Shells) and ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess", "ConnectionAttempt")
| where isnotempty(RemoteIP) and not(ipv4_is_private(RemoteIP)) and RemoteIP !startswith "127."
| summarize Connections = count(), Destinations = make_set(coalesce(RemoteUrl, RemoteIP), 10), Ports = make_set(RemotePort), Commands = make_set(InitiatingProcessCommandLine, 3),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessAccountName
| extend Severity = case(InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("mshta.exe", "regsvr32.exe", "rundll32.exe", "certutil.exe", "msbuild.exe", "installutil.exe"), "1-High", "2-Medium")
| order by Severity asc, Connections desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Net = external_table('DeviceNetworkEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_device) or DeviceName contains _device
| where isempty(_account) or InitiatingProcessAccountName =~ _account;
let MinConnections = 20;
let MaxJitter = 0.2;
Net
| where ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess" and isnotempty(RemoteIP) and not(ipv4_is_private(RemoteIP))
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort, Proc = InitiatingProcessFileName
| sort by DeviceName asc, RemoteIP asc, Proc asc, TimeGenerated asc
| extend Delta = iff(prev(DeviceName) == DeviceName and prev(RemoteIP) == RemoteIP and prev(Proc) == Proc, datetime_diff('second', TimeGenerated, prev(TimeGenerated)), long(null))
| where isnotnull(Delta) and Delta > 0
| summarize Connections = count(), AvgSeconds = avg(Delta), StdSeconds = stdev(Delta), Url = take_any(RemoteUrl), Ports = make_set(RemotePort, 5) by DeviceName, RemoteIP, Proc
| where Connections >= MinConnections
| extend Jitter = round(StdSeconds / max_of(AvgSeconds, 1.0), 2), AvgSeconds = round(AvgSeconds, 0)
| extend Severity = case(Jitter <= MaxJitter and Proc !in~ ("msedge.exe", "chrome.exe", "firefox.exe", "teams.exe", "ms-teams.exe", "onedrive.exe", "outlook.exe", "svchost.exe", "mssense.exe", "msmpeng.exe"), "1-High (regular beacon, unusual process)",
                         Jitter <= MaxJitter, "2-Medium (regular beacon)", "3-Low")
| project Severity, DeviceName, Proc, RemoteIP, Url, Ports, Connections, AvgSeconds, Jitter
| order by Severity asc, Jitter asc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Net = external_table('DeviceNetworkEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_device) or DeviceName contains _device
| where isempty(_account) or InitiatingProcessAccountName =~ _account;
let BadPorts = dynamic([4444, 4445, 1337, 31337, 8888, 9001, 9030, 9050, 9150, 6667, 6697, 5555, 2222, 50050, 1080, 3128, 8443]);
Net
| where RemotePort in (BadPorts) and isnotempty(RemoteIP) and not(ipv4_is_private(RemoteIP))
| summarize Connections = count(), Success = countif(ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess"), Processes = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 5), Urls = make_set(RemoteUrl, 5), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by DeviceName, RemoteIP, RemotePort
| extend Country = tostring(geo_info_from_ip_address(RemoteIP).country)
| extend Severity = case(Success > 0 and RemotePort in (4444, 1337, 31337, 9001, 9050, 50050), "1-High", Success > 0, "2-Medium", "3-Low (attempts)")
| order by Severity asc, Connections desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Net = external_table('DeviceNetworkEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_device) or DeviceName contains _device
| where isempty(_account) or InitiatingProcessAccountName =~ _account;
Net
| where ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess" and isnotempty(RemoteIP) and not(ipv4_is_private(RemoteIP))
| extend Dest = iff(isnotempty(RemoteUrl), tolower(RemoteUrl), RemoteIP)
| summarize Devices = dcount(DeviceName), Device = take_any(DeviceName), Process = take_any(InitiatingProcessFileName), Connections = count(), Port = take_any(RemotePort), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated) by Dest
| where Devices == 1
| where Process !in~ ("msedge.exe", "chrome.exe", "firefox.exe", "svchost.exe", "msmpeng.exe", "mssense.exe", "onedrive.exe", "teams.exe", "ms-teams.exe", "officeclicktorun.exe")
| order by FirstSeen desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Net = external_table('DeviceNetworkEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_device) or DeviceName contains _device
| where isempty(_account) or InitiatingProcessAccountName =~ _account;
Net
| where ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess" and isnotempty(RemoteIP) and not(ipv4_is_private(RemoteIP))
| summarize Connections = count() by RemoteIP
| extend G = geo_info_from_ip_address(RemoteIP)
| extend Latitude = todouble(G.latitude), Longitude = todouble(G.longitude), Country = tostring(G.country)
| where isnotnull(Latitude) and isnotnull(Longitude)
| summarize Connections = sum(Connections) by Longitude, Latitude, Country

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Proc = external_table('DeviceProcessEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_device) or DeviceName contains _device
| where isempty(_account) or AccountName =~ _account or AccountUpn =~ _account;
Proc
| extend Cmd = tolower(ProcessCommandLine)
| extend Technique = case(
    Cmd has "vssadmin" and Cmd has_any ("delete shadows", "resize shadowstorage"), "vssadmin delete/resize shadows",
    Cmd has "shadowcopy" and Cmd has "delete", "WMIC shadowcopy delete",
    Cmd has "win32_shadowcopy" and Cmd has_any ("delete", "remove-"), "PowerShell shadow copy delete",
    Cmd has "wbadmin" and Cmd has_any ("delete catalog", "delete systemstatebackup", "delete backup"), "wbadmin delete",
    Cmd has "bcdedit" and Cmd has_any ("recoveryenabled no", "bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"), "bcdedit recovery disabled",
    Cmd has "diskshadow" and Cmd has "delete", "diskshadow delete",
    "")
| where isnotempty(Technique)
| project TimeGenerated, Severity = "1-Critical", Technique, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine, Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Proc = external_table('DeviceProcessEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_device) or DeviceName contains _device
| where isempty(_account) or AccountName =~ _account or AccountUpn =~ _account;
let Targets = dynamic(["vss","sql","veeam","backup","sophos","mcafee","symantec","windefend","sense","msexchange","acronis","sql server","mysql","oracle","vmware","bits","wuauserv","memtas","mepocs","sophos"]);
Proc
| extend Cmd = tolower(ProcessCommandLine)
| where (FileName in~ ("net.exe", "net1.exe") and Cmd has "stop") or (FileName =~ "sc.exe" and Cmd has_any ("stop", "config") and Cmd has_any ("disabled", "stop"))
     or (FileName =~ "taskkill.exe" and Cmd has "/f") or Cmd has_any ("stop-service", "set-service")
| where Cmd has_any (Targets)
| summarize Commands = count(), Services = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by DeviceName, AccountName
| extend Severity = case(Commands >= 5, "1-High (mass service stop)", "2-Medium")
| order by Severity asc, Commands desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Evt = external_table('DeviceEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_device) or DeviceName contains _device
| where isempty(_account) or InitiatingProcessAccountName =~ _account;
Evt
| where ActionType in ("AntivirusDetection", "AntivirusDetectionActionType", "AntivirusMalwareBlocked")
| extend AF = todynamic(tostring(AdditionalFields))
| extend Threat = tostring(AF.ThreatName), Action = tostring(AF.Action), WasRemediated = tostring(AF.WasRemediated)
| summarize Detections = count(), Devices = dcount(DeviceName), DeviceList = make_set(DeviceName, 10), Files = make_set(FileName, 5), Paths = make_set(FolderPath, 3),
            Remediated = countif(WasRemediated in~ ("true", "1")), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Threat
| extend Severity = case(Remediated < Detections, "1-High (not all remediated)", Threat has_any ("Ransom", "HackTool", "Mimikatz", "CobaltStrike", "Meterpreter"), "1-High", "2-Medium")
| order by Severity asc, Detections desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Evt = external_table('DeviceEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_device) or DeviceName contains _device
| where isempty(_account) or InitiatingProcessAccountName =~ _account;
Evt
| where ActionType startswith "Asr" or ActionType startswith "ControlledFolderAccess" or ActionType startswith "ExploitGuard"
| extend Blocked = ActionType endswith "Blocked"
| summarize Events = count(), Blocked = countif(Blocked), Audited = countif(not(Blocked)), Devices = dcount(DeviceName), DeviceList = make_set(DeviceName, 10),
            Processes = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 5), Files = make_set(FileName, 5), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by ActionType
| extend Severity = case(ActionType has_any ("Ransomware", "ControlledFolderAccess", "LsassCredentialTheft", "PsexecWmi"), "1-High", Audited > 0, "2-Medium (audit only - not blocked)", "3-Low")
| order by Severity asc, Events desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let EpAlerts = external_table('AlertInfo')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where ServiceSource has_any ("Endpoint", "Defender for Endpoint", "Antivirus") or DetectionSource has_any ("EDR", "Antivirus", "Endpoint", "Custom detection", "Automated investigation")
| extend PA = pack_all()
| project AlertTime = TimeGenerated, AlertId, Title, Severity, Category, DetectionSource, Techniques = tostring(PA.AttackTechniques);
let AlertDev = external_table('AlertEvidence')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend PE = pack_all()
| extend DevName = tostring(PE.DeviceName), EvUser = tostring(PE.AccountName)
| where isnotempty(DevName)
| summarize Users = make_set_if(EvUser, isnotempty(EvUser), 5) by AlertId, DevName
| where isempty(_device) or DevName contains _device;
EpAlerts
| where Title has_any ("ransom", "encrypt", "human-operated", "hands-on-keyboard", "shadow cop", "backup", "wiper", "Cobalt Strike", "Sliver", "Brute Ratel")
| join kind=leftouter AlertDev on AlertId
| summarize Devices = make_set(DevName, 10), Users = make_set(Users, 10) by AlertTime, AlertId, Title, Severity, Category
| extend SevRank = case(Severity =~ "High", 1, Severity =~ "Medium", 2, Severity =~ "Low", 3, 4)
| order by SevRank asc, AlertTime desc
| project-away SevRank
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Seen = union
 (external_table('DeviceProcessEvents') | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | summarize LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by DeviceName),
 (external_table('DeviceNetworkEvents') | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | summarize LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by DeviceName);
Seen
| summarize LastSeen = max(LastSeen) by DeviceName
| where isempty(_device) or DeviceName contains _device
| extend HoursSilent = datetime_diff('hour', now(), LastSeen)
| where HoursSilent >= 24
| extend Severity = case(HoursSilent >= 72, "1-High (silent 3+ days)", "2-Medium (silent 1+ day)")
| order by HoursSilent desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Net = external_table('DeviceNetworkEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_device) or DeviceName contains _device
| where isempty(_account) or InitiatingProcessAccountName =~ _account;
Net
| where ActionType == "InboundConnectionAccepted" and LocalPort in (3389, 445, 22, 5985, 5986, 135, 1433, 3306)
| where isnotempty(RemoteIP) and not(ipv4_is_private(RemoteIP)) and RemoteIP !startswith "127."
| summarize Connections = count(), Sources = dcount(RemoteIP), SampleSources = make_set(RemoteIP, 10), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by DeviceName, LocalPort
| extend Severity = case(LocalPort in (3389, 445, 135, 1433, 3306), "1-High (exposed service)", "2-Medium")
| order by Severity asc, Sources desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Proc = external_table('DeviceProcessEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_device) or DeviceName contains _device
| where isempty(_account) or AccountName =~ _account or AccountUpn =~ _account;
let UserPaths = dynamic([@"\appdata\local\temp\", @"\downloads\", @"\users\public\", @"\programdata\", @"\appdata\roaming\", @"\windows\temp\", @"\perflogs\"]);
Proc
| where FileName in~ ("rundll32.exe", "regsvr32.exe", "odbcconf.exe", "control.exe")
| extend Cmd = tolower(ProcessCommandLine)
| where Cmd has_any (UserPaths) or Cmd has_any (".dat,", ".tmp,", ".png,", ".jpg,", ".txt,", ".log,")
| extend Target = replace_string(tostring(split(tostring(split(Cmd, ",")[0]), " ")[-1]), '"', '')
| summarize Executions = count(), Devices = dcount(DeviceName), DeviceList = make_set(DeviceName, 5), Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 5),
            Accounts = make_set(AccountName, 5), SampleCommand = take_any(ProcessCommandLine), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by FileName, Target
| extend Severity = case(tostring(Parents) has_any ("winword", "excel", "outlook", "powershell", "wscript", "cscript", "mshta", "cmd"), "1-High (launched by Office/script)", Devices == 1, "2-Medium (rare)", "3-Low")
| order by Severity asc, Executions desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Proc = external_table('DeviceProcessEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_device) or DeviceName contains _device
| where isempty(_account) or AccountName =~ _account or AccountUpn =~ _account;
Proc
| where isnotempty(_device) or isnotempty(_account)
| summarize Executions = count(), SampleCommand = take_any(ProcessCommandLine), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by GrandParent = InitiatingProcessParentFileName, Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName, Child = FileName
| order by Executions asc, LastSeen desc
| take 200
